fusions.name: Slow Wake
fusions.desc: Pushes a slow wake into the cone ahead of you, which deals 3 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Blow
fusions.desc: A slow, heavy blow that deals 28 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Warm Shallows
fusions.desc: Warms the water where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Drift Until Rested
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you drift and restore 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
